screen:
Minister Salary
You join the public service. The formula that sets the Prime Minister's pay is published, and so is the distance between you and it.

Your name: Jia Hui (Female)
You chose: Local Graduate (NORMAL)
Good degree, no scholarship, no bond. You applied through Careers@Gov like everyone else, and start as a Management Executive.

One tap is one year, and every year ends with an appraisal grade. A or B+ gets you considered for promotion; two Ds in a row and you are asked to leave. Choices are permanent, and some of them come back.

Management Executive [MX13]   $0 LIFETIME EARNINGS
Age 23 · Year 1 · Ministry of Manpower

You've been a Management Executive at the Ministry of Manpower for eight months, mostly drafting replies to letters from the public. Your reporting officer is Mr Ridzwan, a Deputy Director.   A) Ask Mr Ridzwan for harder work.

  C) Keep your head down and clear the letters.
